sections.heading: Flagged items in detail
paragraphs: Current Ratio Liquidity: Current assets cover current liabilities 0.81 times. Liquidity is tight relative to short-term obligations.
Gross Margin Stability: Gross margin varied with a standard deviation of 4.1 percentage points. Margin volatility suggests commodity exposure or weak pricing power.
Operating Margin Stability: Operating margin standard deviation of 4.1 pp indicates cost swings that make forecasting unreliable.
Share Dilution Check: The share count changed +10.3% a year. Dilution transfers value from existing holders to new issuance.
ROE vs. ROCE Quality: Return on capital employed of 10.0% with ROE of 8.5% is close to or below the cost of capital, so growth destroys rather than creates value.
Earnings Volatility Check: Earnings per share fell in 2 of the last 4 years with a growth standard deviation of 60 points. Earnings are erratic, which argues for a wider margin of safety.
Book Value Compounding: Book value per share compounded -1.6% annually. Retained earnings are not translating into balance-sheet growth.

Auditor & Governance Cleanliness: Aggregating the accounting evidence: 4 hard red flags and 3 watch items, with a LojikX™ Consistency Score of 74/100. The pattern of flags warrants a closer read of the auditor notes and related-party disclosures.
